title: Make agent-authored browser domain skills discoverable as individual SKILL.md entries
classification_rationale: The pinned Index S1=A assessment (2026-09-18) and exploratory 2026-09-22 learned-regulator note identify Browser Harness's agent-editable S1 operational repertoire and its consumption boundary. Source issue browser-use/browser-harness#155 independently documents the exact lazy-loader discoverability problem. The new opt-in native exporter makes existing S1 domain rules addressable by SKILL.md indexers. This is an assessment-informed functional hypothesis, not an Index-first specific prediction or proof of endogenous learning.
next_action: Code and native functional proof are ready in the pinned fork branch; show the exact fork-local PR title/body, verified 5-file diff and all evidence URLs to the owner, and obtain separate exact current-conversation consent BEFORE creating the PUBLIC fork-local review PR. External PR not created or authorized. No LLM outcome or autonomous skill-learning improvement claimed.

functional_evidence.actor: User or coding agent integrating Browser Harness domain workflows with a lazy-loaded SKILL.md-indexing agent such as Hermes.
functional_evidence.task: Convert existing site-specific Markdown into separately name-addressable SKILL.md entries without loading the primary Browser Harness skill or starting a daemon.
functional_evidence.before: 174 first-party domain skill Markdown files in pinned current original; 0 SKILL.md entries in their tree. BH_DOMAIN_SKILLS only surfaces filenames after a navigation; manual per-session search/copy is the original alternative.
functional_evidence.after: Opt-in CLI export produces 174 individually named SKILL.md files with valid name/description frontmatter and preserved source bodies. Independent fresh scanner process found 174, including browser-harness-github-repo-actions; second run created none and left 174 unchanged.
functional_evidence.native_tests: PYTHONPATH=src ../browser-harness/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/unit : 274 passed, 1 skipped on product branch source; clean baseline 266 passed, 1 skipped in the separately pinned clean worktree.
functional_evidence.negative_controls: Unmanaged and modified output files are not overwritten; unsafe symlinks, source-output recursion, naming collisions and partial preflight conflicts are rejected; existing CLI never starts daemon during export; source Markdown unchanged.
functional_evidence.vsm_scope: S1 operational repertoire accessibility only. No proof the LLM reads/chooses a skill, improved real task outcome, independent learning, or change to canonical S1 autonomy grade.
functional_evidence.overlap: Original issue #155 completed historically; PR #163 closed unmerged (documentation only); PR #1025 implements saved script replay, not SKILL.md indexing; PR #908 handles the primary skill/Cloud behavior, not export.
functional_evidence.disposition: Material narrow functional delta supported by native integration; external agent task outcome remains untested.

validation_summary.not_validated: No live Hermes agent or another full lazy-loader integration test; no LLM choosing/using a skill, no task-quality A/B, no endogenous construction, no output pruning on deleted source files, no security certification of imported website instructions.
